```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(tidymodels)
library(gbm)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
library(patchwork)
library(corrplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(DALEX)
```
# Load the data
```{r}
load("severity.RData")
dat <- na.omit(dat)
cat(
  "Number of observations removed due to N/A:",
  sum(!complete.cases(dat))
)
set.seed(4027)
my_dat <- dat[sample(nrow(dat), 1000), ]
```

```{r}
# Correlations
continuous_vars <- my_dat %>%
  select(
    age,
    height,
    weight,
    bmi,
    SBP,
    LDL,
    depression
  )

cor_matrix <- cor(continuous_vars)

corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.7
)
```

```{r}
my_dat <- my_dat %>%
  select(-id, -height, -weight)
```

# Convert Variables
```{r}
my_dat <- my_dat %>%
  mutate(
    severity = factor(severity,
                      levels = c(0,1),
                      labels = c("NotSevere","Severe")),

    gender = factor(gender,
                    levels = c(0,1),
                    labels = c("Female","Male")),

    hypertension = factor(hypertension,
                    levels = c(0,1),
                    labels = c("No","Yes")),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes,
               levels = c(0,1),
               labels = c("No","Yes")),
    vaccine = factor(vaccine,
              levels = c(0,1),
              labels = c("Not vaccinated","Vaccinated")),

    race = factor(race,
                  levels = c(1,2,3,4),
                  labels = c("White","Asian","Black","Hispanic")),

    smoking = factor(smoking,
                     levels = c(0,1,2),
                     labels = c("Never","Former","Current"))
  )
```

# Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(1234)
split <- initial_split(my_dat,
                       prop = 0.8,
                       strata = severity)

train_dat <- training(split)
test_dat  <- testing(split)
```

summary_table <- train_dat %>%

summary_table

# Logistic Regression
```{r}
logit_fit <- glm(
  severity ~ age + gender + race + smoking +
    bmi + hypertension + diabetes +
    SBP + LDL + vaccine + depression,
  data = train_dat,
  family = binomial
)

summary(logit_fit)
```

```{r}
# OR
exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(logit_fit),
  confint(logit_fit)
))

# Plot
or_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef(summary(logit_fit))),
  OR = exp(coef(logit_fit))
)
or_df <- or_df %>%
  filter(Variable != "(Intercept)") %>%
  arrange(desc(OR))
ggplot(
  or_df,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Variable, OR),
    y = OR
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Odds Ratios from Logistic Regression",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Odds Ratio"
  )
```

```{r}
# Predicted Probabilities
logit_prob <- predict(
  logit_fit,
  newdata = test_dat,
  type = "response"
)
```

```{r}
# ROC
roc_logit <- roc(
  response = test_dat$severity,
  predictor = logit_prob,
  levels = c("NotSevere","Severe")
)

auc_logit <- auc(roc_logit)

plot(
  roc_logit,
  main = "ROC Curve - Logistic Regression",
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = paste("AUC =", round(auc_logit, 3)),
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
# Predictions
logit_pred <- ifelse(logit_prob > 0.5,
                     "Severe",
                     "NotSevere")

logit_pred <- factor(
  logit_pred,
  levels = c("NotSevere","Severe")
)

# Confusion matrix
cm_logit <- confusionMatrix(
  data = logit_pred,
  reference = test_dat$severity,
  positive = "Severe"
)

cm_logit_df <- as.data.frame(cm_logit$table)
# Plot
ggplot(cm_logit_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgreen", high = "darkgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix - Logistic Regression",
    x = "Actual Class",
    y = "Predicted Class",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

# Boosting
```{r}
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 5,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
)
```

```{r}
# tuning grid
gbm.grid <- expand.grid(
  n.trees = c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000),
  interaction.depth = 1:4,
  shrinkage = c(0.005, 0.01, 0.05),
  n.minobsinnode = 10
)
```

```{r}
# Train
set.seed(4027)

gbm_fit <- train(
  severity ~ .,
  data = train_dat,
  method = "gbm",
  metric = "ROC",
  tuneGrid = gbm.grid,
  trControl = ctrl,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(gbm_fit)
```
```{r}
# Best parameters
gbm_fit$bestTune
```

```{r}
gbm_prob <- predict(
  gbm_fit,
  newdata = test_dat,
  type = "prob"
)[,"Severe"]
```

```{r}
roc_gbm <- roc(
  response = test_dat$severity,
  predictor = gbm_prob,
  levels = c("NotSevere","Severe")
)

auc_gbm <- auc(roc_gbm)

plot(
  roc_gbm,
  main = "ROC Curve - Boosting",
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = paste(
    "AUC =",
    round(auc_gbm, 3)
  ),
  bty = "n"
)
```

```{r}
gbm_pred <- predict(
  gbm_fit,
  newdata = test_dat
)

cm_gbm <- confusionMatrix(
  data = gbm_pred,
  reference = test_dat$severity,
  positive = "Severe"
)

cm_gbm_df <- as.data.frame(cm_gbm$table)

ggplot(
  cm_gbm_df,
  aes(
    x = Reference,
    y = Prediction,
    fill = Freq
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Freq)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightgreen",
    high = "darkgreen"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix - Boosting",
    x = "Actual",
    y = "Predicted"
  )
```

```{r}
summary(gbm_fit$finalModel, las = 2, cBars = 19, cex.names = 0.6)
```

# SVM
```{r}
set.seed(4027)

radial.tune <- tune.svm(
  severity ~ .,
  data = train_dat,
  kernel = "radial",
  probability = TRUE,
  cost = exp(seq(0, 4, length = 8)),
  gamma = exp(seq(-8, -3, length = 6))
)
```

```{r}
plot(
  radial.tune,
  transform.y = log,
  transform.x = log,
  color.palette = terrain.colors
)
```
```{r}
radial.tune$best.parameters
```
```{r}
best.radial <- radial.tune$best.model
summary(best.radial)
```

```{r}
pred.radial <- predict(
  best.radial,
  newdata = test_dat
)
cm_svm <- confusionMatrix(
  data = pred.radial,
  reference = test_dat$severity,
  positive = "Severe"
)
cm_svm_df <- as.data.frame(cm_svm$table)
colnames(cm_svm_df) <- c("Prediction", "Reference", "Freq")
ggplot(cm_svm_df,
       aes(x = Reference,
           y = Prediction,
           fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq),
            size = 8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightgreen",
                      high = "darkgreen") +

  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix - Radial SVM",
    x = "Actual Class",
    y = "Predicted Class"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    text = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
# Predicted probabilities
svm_prob <- predict(
  best.radial,
  newdata = test_dat,
  probability = TRUE
)

svm_prob <- attr(
  svm_prob,
  "probabilities"
)[,"Severe"]
```

```{r}
#ROC/AUC
roc_svm <- roc(
  response = test_dat$severity,
  predictor = svm_prob,
  levels = c("NotSevere","Severe")
)

svm_auc <- auc(roc_svm)

plot(
  roc_svm,
  main = "ROC Curve - SVM"
)
legend("bottomright",  legend = paste("AUC =", round(svm_auc, 3)),  bty = "n",  cex = 1.2)
```
```{r}
explainer_svm <- explain(
  model = best.radial,

  data = train_dat %>%
    select(-severity),

  y = as.numeric(train_dat$severity == "Severe"),

  label = "Radial SVM",

  verbose = FALSE
)


svm_vi <- model_parts(
  explainer_svm,
  type = "difference"
)


svm_vi_df <- svm_vi %>%
  as.data.frame()

svm_vi_df <- svm_vi_df %>%
  filter(
    variable != "_baseline_",
    variable != "_full_model_"
  )

ggplot(
  svm_vi_df,
  aes(
    x = reorder(variable, dropout_loss),
    y = dropout_loss
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "SVM Variable Importance",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Importance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

# Model Comparison
```{r}
# Model comparison table

comparison_table <- tibble(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "Boosting", "SVM"),
  
  Accuracy = c(
    cm_logit$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_gbm$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm_svm$overall["Accuracy"]
  ),
  
  Sensitivity = c(
    cm_logit$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_gbm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm_svm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  ),
  
  Specificity = c(
    cm_logit$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_gbm$byClass["Specificity"],
    cm_svm$byClass["Specificity"]
  ),
  
  AUC = c(
    as.numeric(auc_logit),
    as.numeric(auc_gbm),
    as.numeric(svm_auc)
  )
)
comparison_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Model Comparison")
```
